figures.caption: Table 1 Slope K of the Heckel plot in stage II and compressive stress at 97% TD of SE powders. Because the y-axis of the Heckel plot uses the natural logarithm, the variation in compressive strength increases signiﬁcantly as the density approaches 100% TD. In the case of Li6PS5Cl, only Li6PS5Br was refined, as the distinction between S and Cl was not possible from the XRD data.
